'''Goretongue''' was a particularly large and dangerous [[minstyngar]] thrasher that lived on the [[Rryatt Trail#Wroshyr Canopy|Wroshyr Canopy]] level of the [[Rryatt Trail]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Behind the scenes==
Goretongue was a creature in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. It could be found on the Wroshyr Canopy level of the Rryatt Trail. It was a level 64 [[:w:c:swg:Elite|Gold Chevron boss]], which meant that it was much stronger and tougher than normal minstyngars and even posed a threat to players with higher levels. It was not involved in any quests and did not necessarily need to be killed by the player.
